  (4, '2027-01-01'::DATE)
) v(n, d)))
WHERE d = '2026-05-06'::DATE ORDER BY n;

records.reason: DataFusion's native arrow_cast constructs and compares the same Arrow millisecond-resolution timestamps without DuckDB's TIMESTAMP_MS type spelling.

DataFusion can construct millisecond timestamps with arrow_cast, but its table-function scalar-subquery seam cannot carry both n and ts as top-level columns. Struct packing would change the VGI input schema.
